messages:
lia: heads up — getting repeated compute_slot_low alert for hosted-usw1, spikes every ~3m
sam: saw it too, queue depth on the compute queue is climbing, admission control started rejecting small requests :grimacing:
lia: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/compute-capacity?orgId=1&from=now-1h — panels show free_slots falling from ~120 -> 15
amanda: any recent deploys to hosted us-west-1? could be new models spun up
sam: nope, no deploys. node churn looks normal but provisioning latency is high (~140s)
ops-oncall: provisioning latency? that's the cloud instance boot/attach time or our pool allocator?
sam: looks like cloud infra (AZ-level) — a couple of cycles with slow attach; autoscaler kept trying to spin new GPU nodes but they stayed stuck in provisioning
lia: PromQL I used:
```
sum(free_compute_slots{region="usw1"}) by (pool)

topk(5, sum(rate(requests_total{region="usw1"}[1m])) by (model))
```

sam: also saw a growing tail on request_latency_ms and KV cache warmup slowed so more tokens being emitted
sre-bot: alert: compute_slot_low (severity: warning) — triggered 6x in last 20m
lia: workaround applied: routed burst traffic to hosted-usw2 via routing policy change (temporary).
amanda: can we increase reserved capacity for hosted-usw1 short term? finance ok with the delta? :thinking_face:
sam: estimated cost for 12h bump: ~$3.2k. ops-oncall ok with temporary spend
ops-oncall: I'll open a short ticket to bump reserved nodes and keep autoscaler threshold lower for next 2h
dev-platform: filing postmortem candidate — adding link to dashboard and provisioning logs to the ticket
lia: follow-up action: add alert for provisioning_latency > 60s so we detect cloud-side slow attach earlier
sam: also suggest tuning admission controller to prefer draining/evicting lower-priority requests earlier instead of hard rejects
amanda: noted. will schedule a config change in the canary policy
ops-oncall: resolved? provisioning latency dropped after routing change and a handful of stuck instances cleared. last 5m free slots ~110
sre-bot: alert cleared compute_slot_low
lia: thanks team. I'll add a short runbook step for routing bursts cross-region and an ops note about reservation ramp
sam: +1
